in the folder /home/jvanniekerk/RiderProjects/Zapper.TeamLead.Assignment/src/intent/.specs you will find a SDD collection of resources the tasks.md file and traceability.json file serve as trackers on where we are in the developmet of the coding assignment

The really important stuff intems of analysis and design is in this folder with the primary source of truth being Zapper - Team_lead Assignment.pdf/.md  
/home/jvanniekerk/RiderProjects/Zapper.TeamLead.Assignment/src/intent/docs

Please go through these and esure that we are up to date and complete up to Task 3, that we have a full set of unit and integration tests, that the setup and docker file includes a SQL server and Redis distributed cache container and that the database project dacpac is deployed to the SQL server using SQL dac deploy instead of EF schema migrations. also please ensure that all transactional queries and commands, with audit and logging are stored in the database and that all requirements are served from the infrastructure layer with a straight through redis cache, the dotnet layer needs to be stateless, the redis cache needs to be stateful to service an elestic scaling architecture. All IO from th edatabase should come from Stored Procedures and envoked without magic strings, I suggest a set of extension abstractions that surface sproc names and parameters in a way that is hardened against known issues, redis straight through should flush on write operations and server from reads, when we cache a collection we cache each item individually so that we dont have to refresh entire data set collections when we change one record. Additonally ensure that query path and SQL stats are made efficient with the appropriate indexes and composite indexes where needed, taking into account that we have parameter sniffing where sproc parameters should be mapped to internal declared varaibles used in the sproc so that the query plans for the sproc params is not linked to their use in the actual procedure avoiding degrated experience over time, also queries should not return large data sets, sprocs that do should be thought about because these degrade over time when the data sets increase in the number of records returned. Every sproc should have its own model meaning no sproc set should use the same class because changing that sproc means breaking another one. 

Primary objective ensure that all tasks and requirements have been met up to task 3 and that we have a document pointing us to the actual code that does that work for an easy tour, because there is a lot of boilerplate code and assessing this all is labourious and not necessary. 

For seeding of test data, we are going to use initialisation stored procedures with Merge in a non non-destructive idempotent way, gated to ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT Development and Staging

SQL and Redis Containers should be free/developer tier for Stagig and Development, the use of AWS app configuration for environment configuration with EnvironmentVariables taking precedence including a module for feature flags from AWS envronment configuration that also works with environment variables.

/home/jvanniekerk/RiderProjects/Zapper.TeamLead.Assignment/src/AcmeIntegreatedAssessement/AcmeIntegreatedAssessement.Api/Dockerfile /home/jvanniekerk/RiderProjects/Zapper.TeamLead.Assignment/src/AcmeIntegreatedAssessement/AcmeIntegreatedAssessement.Api/Dokerfile only has a net 8 container layer, we need to also have the SQL server developer edition, redis free tier, with Database SQL dac deploy. each container needs networking between them, the dotnet app needs an NGINX reverse proxy with confd to route to our dotnet app and act as our SSL termination layer (using CF orange cloud origin cert, key and CA certificate, SQL, redis and dotnet containers can allows SSH connction or SSH proxy to connect to the DB using tools like Datagrip it should look a bit like a Jelastic JPS environment (Virtuozzo)

using playwrite take a walk through the application front end and ensure that the features are all sufficiently exposed also run the test suite and produce a test output artifact showing tests run and pass / fail

use the /impeccable skill and build a front end that meets the needs of the requirements implemented in the application described here /home/jvanniekerk/RiderProjects/Zapper.TeamLead.Assignment/docs ensure the full featured UI is created end to end make all the decisions

great once again use playwrite to run through the UI screen shot everything and compose a reproduceable test suite that can do the same series of tests, speckflow is deprecated so use a gherkin-like implementation with a playwrite core, also while you are there, throw in some unit tests I see our unit test project is very thin.
